title: How ALKU Cut Time to First Deal in Half by Scaling Repetition
summary: Cut ramp time in half and scale sales training without adding managers. See how ALKU used Hyperbound to give reps unlimited practice, accelerate time to first deal from 6 to 3 months, and turn repetition into real performance across 300+ sellers.
body_markdown:
## **About ALKU**


[ALKU](https://link.alku.com/unTa1) is a specialty staffing firm that helps companies find hard-to-place talent across life sciences, IT, and government, built on hiring entry-level account managers and recruiters, then training them into high-performing sellers from scratch.


Under the leadership of Andrew Bull (CEO), alongside Michael O’Brien (Senior Director of Sales Strategy) and James Cassin-Reed (VP of Revenue Strategy), the team faced a new challenge:


**How do you scale skill development when reps need repetition to get better… but real conversations are limited?**


## **The Challenge: Not Enough At-Bats**


ALKU’s model depends on repetition.


But in reality, reps weren’t getting enough at-bats.


They could make hundreds of calls and only speak to a handful of people. Most conversations never happened, which meant most learning never happened either.


Reps weren’t struggling because they weren’t working hard.


They were struggling because they didn’t have enough chances to practice.


And while roleplay was already known to be one of the most effective parts of training, it couldn’t keep up.


As the internship program scaled to hundreds of reps, training hit a wall. There simply weren’t enough managers or teammates to run the volume of practice needed to actually build skill.


## **The Breakthrough: From Months to Hours**


Hyperbound changed one thing:


**It gave reps unlimited repetition.**


Instead of waiting weeks to accumulate real conversations, reps could now simulate them on demand, running through full calls, over and over again.


What used to take a month of dialing could now be done in a single session.


Practice was no longer dependent on pickup rates, timing, or manager availability.


It became consistent, repeatable, and always available, whether reps were onboarding, preparing for a call, or just trying to get better.


## **The Transformation: Faster Ramp, Better Reps, Scalable Training**


The impact showed up quickly and across the entire organization.


### **1. Time to first closed deal dropped significantly.**


What used to take around **6 months** now takes closer to **3 months** .


Reps are closing their first opportunities in half the time, accelerating the path from hiring to revenue contribution.


### **2. Reps gained experience faster and built confidence earlier.**


Before Hyperbound, it could take **weeks or months** to accumulate enough real conversations to improve.


Now, reps can simulate that same volume of experience in a single session, practicing more frequently and building confidence before stepping into live calls. And they’re doing so in an environment that won’t cost them real relationships with clients.


That compression fundamentally changed how quickly reps develop skill.


### **3. Training scaled across the organization.**


ALKU expanded its internship program to **300+ participants** without increasing coaching capacity.


What once required constant manager involvement could now happen independently across hundreds of reps at once.


## **From Practice to Hyperbound Perform**


As reps ramped faster, a new challenge emerged:


**How do you ensure that practice translates into real performance?**


Before Hyperbound, ALKU had limited visibility into what was actually happening on calls. They weren’t recording any calls with their prospects or clients.


Coaching depended on managers being present in the moment. If they missed the call, they missed the opportunity to coach or had to depend on a rep’s biased self-reflection.


With Hyperbound Perform, that changed.


Managers could now review real conversations, understand where reps were struggling, and connect that directly back to targeted practice.


Instead of generic feedback, coaching became specific, consistent, and actionable.


Hyperbound Perform allowed reps to improve on the exact moments that mattered in live deals on top of the practice they were getting with the AI roleplays.


## **Changing the Pace of Performance**


At ALKU, the goal wasn’t to improve training. The goal was to remove the constraints that slowed down performance.


For years, skill development was tied to one thing:


**How many real conversations a rep could get.**


That made improvement slow, inconsistent, and hard to scale.


By removing call volume as the bottleneck, ALKU changed that dynamic entirely. Reps no longer have to wait weeks to build experience; they can build it before it ever matters.


And when that happens, everything speeds up:


- ramp
- productivity
- overall performance


**The result is a faster path from hiring to performance across the entire organization.**
